cards: Rotate nginx logs on web-1 to free disk space (web-1) — succeeded on 2026-09-23. Worked: `ssh web-1 'sudo logrotate -f /etc/logrotate.d/nginx'`. Dead ends: `ssh web-1 'rm /var/log/nginx/access.log'` (permission denied without sudo). Lesson: Use sudo with logrotate instead of manually deleting log files

Build the docker image for the billing service (terminal) — abandoned on 2026-09-23. Dead ends: `docker build -t billing:latest services/billing` (Dockerfile not found); `docker build -t billing:latest -f services/billing/docker/Dockerfile .` (build failed during pip install due to unreachable private package index). Lesson: Fix the private package index configuration before attempting to build the image.

Renew TLS certificate for shop.example.com (->) — succeeded on 2026-09-23. Worked: `sudo certbot renew --cert-name shop.example.com --dry-run` → `sudo certbot renew --cert-name shop.example.com && sudo systemctl reload nginx`. Learned from: https://eff-certbot.readthedocs.io/en/stable/using.html#renewing-certificates. Lesson: Always run a dry-run first before executing the actual renewal.

Set up a virtualenv for the reports project and install its requirements (~/reports) — succeeded on 2026-09-23. Worked: `cd ~/reports && rm -rf .venv && python3.12 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt`. Dead ends: `cd ~/reports && python3.9 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt` (Python version mismatch (required >=3.11, found 3.9)). Lesson: Check package Python version requirements before creating the virtualenv
